problems: Cross-dossier conflicts with roman-empire (eu-04-a): it has no matching loss for Spain 261 or gain 269 (its Cliopatria shape keeps Spain throughout, overlapping gallic-empire 261-268); it dates the Palmyrene loss of the East to 267 against 260 here; it dates Egypt late 271 (Crisis of the Third Century page, not opened here) against Oct 270 on the Palmyrene page; it lists Cilicia and Cappadocia, which the Palmyrene page does not.

western-roman-empire ends 480, not 476: Julius Nepos reigned from Dalmatia until 9 May 480 while Italy passed to Odoacer on 4 Sept 476. Change identity.end to 476 if the textbook date is preferred; the Dalmatia keyframe (476-480) and the dissolve event would then move to kingdom-of-odoacer.

Page budgets exceeded: gallic-empire 3 pages, palmyrene-empire 3, western-roman-empire 13 (3 shared with Odoacer and Soissons), kingdom-of-soissons 3. 20 distinct pages opened in all; sources_total 30 is the sum of per-dossier source entries.

Slug merges for eu-06: counterparts vandals (337-438) with vandal-kingdom, visigoths (396-425) with visigothic-kingdom, burgundians with burgundian-kingdom are used as plain Cliopatria slugs; kingdom-of-the-franks stands for Clovis as Soissons's successor (Cliopatria also has salian-franks 358-509).

Cliopatria shapes with data problems: Gallic Empire shapes 261-269 and 270-282 are identical (712,514 km2) and run 8 years past 274; Palmyrene shapes 261-269 already show the 271 maximum and stop at 269; Western Roman Empire has timing errors (Carthage 439 vs 443, Sapaudia 443 vs 451, Tarraconensis 472 and south of the Loire 475 vs 469, Attila's raids drawn as Hunnic land 451/452); Kingdom of Soissons 476-479 includes 121 cells of Dalmatia (Nepos), not Odoacer's Italy as data/README.md suspected.
Family choices: kingdom-of-odoacer uses family italy; constantine-iii-usurper is type rebel under the rome family. Wikidata ids are null for the two new states.
